findings.reason: a worker implementing the deliverable exactly fails its own gate, so it must either drop the template (contradicting the deliverable and losing the provenance the section wants) or withhold the record write; the done-when has to scope the no-placeholder assertion to the resolved field and let the template field carry it.
findings.text: the done-when asserts "the resolved command on the run record and in the composed prompt, with no brace placeholder in either", but the deliverable at :2707 requires dispatch to store the resolved command "on the run record beside the template it came from", and that template is itself the `{node_test_files}` declaration — so a record built as the deliverable demands necessarily carries a brace placeholder, and the first case cannot pass

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` lines 2275 and 2505 are exactly the read and the record write the section names; `reckon/crew/prompts.py:556` is `compose_prompt`; `reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1080` is `_compose_dispatch_prompt`, the single call site at `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2333`; and `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py` carries `SCOPED_SUITE_PLACEHOLDER` and `_scoped_suite_command`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the measure is falsifiable in both cases (resolved command with no placeholder on the record and in the composed prompt; a second case for a scope with no test file) and it names a declared negative control, "storing the template verbatim turns the first case red", which genuinely fails the first case.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the done-when places the base and head arms in `git archive` extractions, which are trees rather than evidence, and the repository's manifest contract carries the gate logs (`test_logs`, under the run directory) for this node.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name or ticket number reaches a symbol, file or comment; the new test file is named for its mechanism.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the deliverable requires the template stored on the run record beside the resolved command, while the done-when requires that the run record carry no brace placeholder, so the measure the section asserts cannot be met by the mechanism it requires.
